shortDescription: Framework for randomly generated "titan" creatures: XML-defined traits with hidden-until-seen discovery, material (stuffed) creatures like steel wolves, inheritance through breeding. Works on any pawn.
body:
## Purpose
Library mod for a later dungeon mod. Gives any pawn (animal, humanlike, mech) a set of rolled traits and a material. Content mods define the traits; this mod handles storage, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, visuals and materials.

## Status
- **Phase 1 (tested, works):** traits, titan hediff, rolling, discovery, naming, inheritance, debug actions.
- **Visuals (tested, user happy):** overlays, flame sprites, effecters.
- **Phase 2 materials (built, build 20; run #23 had no errors, look not yet confirmed by the user).**
- **Phase 3:** AI use of abilities by non-humanlikes, diet-changing traits, humanlike (Biotech) birth inheritance, hiding hidden traits from stat explanations, optional VRE gene compat.

## TitanTraitDef (XML: `<TitanFramework.TitanTraitDef>`)
- **Generation:** `commonality`, `pointCost` (negative = drawback), `exclusionTags`, `tags` (convention: `Weakness`), race filters (`allowAnimals/Humanlikes/Mechanoids/Other`, `requiresFlesh` (flesh races only: no mechs), `disallowConstructs` (not on material creatures; removed if the creature becomes one; for traits working through meat, leather, blood, pain, toxins or rot), `min/maxBodySize`, `allowedRaces`, `disallowedRaces`).
- **Discovery:** `visible`, `discoverWhen` (Manual, UsesGrantedVerb, UsesGrantedAbility, Attacks, TakesDamage, Dies; only when the player can see it), `discoveryMessage`.
- **Naming:** `namePrefix`, `nameSuffix`, `nameOrder`. Only discovered traits.
- **Inheritance:** `heritable`, `inheritChance` (per carrying parent, compounds).
- **Effects:** `stage`, `hediffs`, `abilities`, `traitClass`.
- **Visuals:** `overlays`, `flames`, `effecters`, `scaleEffectersWithBodySize`, `showVisualsWhenHidden`.

## Visuals
- **TitanOverlay:** body (and head) texture redrawn with a glow shader. `color`, `scale`, `layer` (default 1 = over), `alignBottom` + `feetDepth` (0.25), `pulseSpeed`/`pulseMin` (game time), `includeHead`, `shaderType`.
- **TitanFlames:** flickering fire sprites at stable per-creature points on the body. `count`, `size`, `x`/`z`, `verticalFacingWidth`, `color`, `ticksPerFrame`, `layer`, `texFolder`. Drawn in PostDraw from a null-material request.
- Render nodes via DynamicPawnRenderNodeSetup (no Harmony). Skipped on vanilla sculptures (statue flag without a titan material), portraits (flames), invisible pawns (flames).
- **Effecters:** MapComponent ticks every tick; only titans with effecters tracked; dropped while fogged/off-map and rebuilt on return; respawned every 600k ticks; scaled by sqrt(body size). Particles stay where spawned (trail), which the user likes.

## Materials (Phase 2)
- Stored as a ThingDef (stuff) on Hediff_Titan, saved. Always in the name before the kind: "flaming jade bear" (stuffAdjective).
- **API:** `SetMaterial(pawn, stuff)` (null = flesh), `RollMaterial(pawn, validator)`, `GetMaterial`, `IsConstruct`. Rolling picks metal, stone and wood stuffs weighted by stuff commonality × extension commonality.
- **Look:** vanilla statue rendering (`PawnRenderer.SetStatue`), the whole pawn in the stuff colour. Reapplied when the render tree is set up and once per load in TickInterval. Trait overlays/flames still draw on material titans in their own colours. Side effects: no red damage flash; humanlike constructs lose the render cache.
- **Stats (material stage merged into the titan stage):** armour = stuff armour power × 0.5 (`TitanMaterialUtility.ArmorFactor`); stone blocks have no armour stats so 0.5 × their HP factor stands in. MeleeDamageFactor = average of sharp/blunt multipliers. Flammability factor = stuff flammability; Flame/Burn damage × (0.5 + flammability): wood ×1.5, stone ×0.5. Tag "Flammable" for flammability ≥ 0.5 (`TitanMaterialUtility.HasTag`).
- **Construct:** pain 0, bleed 0, ToxicResistance and ToxicEnvironmentResistance +1, VacuumResistance +1 if Odyssey, meat and leather 0. Harmony: no blood filth/smears; corpse never rots (CompRottable.disabled set in MakeCorpse); corpse not edible. Still eats, heals, breeds.
- **Butchering:** yields the stuff, body size × 40 (× 10 for small-volume stuffs like gold) × extension factor × efficiency.
- **Market value:** StatPart_TitanMaterial added to MarketValue at startup (hediff offsets don't reach pawn market value). Counts toward colony wealth.
- **TitanMaterialExtension (DefModExtension on a StuffDef):** `allowRolling`, `forceAllowed` (other categories), `commonality`, `armorFactor`, `damageFactor`, `butcherYieldFactor`, `traits` (granted with the material, flagged fromMaterial, swapped on material change, not inherited alone; disallowConstructs traits are never granted), `tags`.
- Setting a material removes disallowConstructs traits. Inheritance: material from the parent that has one (coin flip if both), set before traits.
- Tooltip: "Made of X" section with its stats.

## Harmony patches (11)
BestKindLabel postfix; DoBirthSpawn and CompHatcher.Hatch prefix/finalizer; TrySpawnHatchedOrBornPawn prefix; DropBloodFilth/DropBloodSmear prefixes; MakeCorpse(Building_Grave,bool,float) postfix; Corpse.IngestibleNow postfix; Pawn.ButcherProducts postfix.

## Known limitations
- Info card stat breakdown shows hidden traits' numbers.
- Hidden traits' abilities may show as gizmos.
- Animals don't use abilities on their own yet.
- Humanlike births don't inherit yet.
- Debug palette pins for our actions fail; don't pin them.
- Saves from before build 17 don't have fromMaterial on material-granted traits (only matters for existing test saves).

## Debug actions (category "Titan Framework")
Add trait…, Roll traits…, Set material… ((flesh), (random), every candidate stuff), Discover all traits, Clear titan.

## Example content (Defs/Examples): remove or move before publishing
Flaming (visible; tint, 3 flame sprites, TF_Effecter_Embers), Venomous (hidden, no race/construct restriction, no visuals), Ironhide, Of the Deep, Brittle.
